description: A dark-skinned man in a worn work shirt and trousers kneels on sand beside a railway track half buried by drifting dunes. He holds a tiny glinting stone up between his fingers and looks at it, a shovel lies on the sand beside him, and a small pale stone sits on the ground. The style is a dusty, dark-toned oil painting under a hazy grey sky, with no text, border or frame.
